Class NettyDataBuffer

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.io.buffer.NettyDataBuffer
All Implemented Interfaces:
DataBuffer, PooledDataBuffer, TouchableDataBuffer
public class NettyDataBuffer extends Object implements PooledDataBuffer
实现 `DataBuffer` 接口以包装 Netty 4 的 `ByteBuf`。通常由 NettyDataBufferFactory 构建。
Since:
5.0
Author:
Arjen Poutsma, Brian Clozel

    • slice

      @Deprecated(since="6.0") public NettyDataBuffer slice(int index, int length)
      Deprecated.
      描述从接口复制：DataBuffer
      Create a new DataBuffer whose contents is a shared subsequence of this data buffer's content. Data between this data buffer and the returned buffer is shared; though changes in the returned buffer's position will not be reflected in the reading nor writing position of this data buffer.

      注意，此方法不会在生成的切片上调用 DataBufferUtils.retain(DataBuffer)：引用计数将不会增加。

      Specified by:
      `slice` 接口 `DataBuffer` 中
      Parameters:
      index - 开始切片的位置索引
      length - 切片长度
      Returns:
      该数据缓冲区的指定切片

      @Deprecated(since="6.0") public NettyDataBuffer retainedSlice(int index, int length)
      Deprecated.
      描述从接口复制：DataBuffer
      Create a new DataBuffer whose contents is a shared, retained subsequence of this data buffer's content. Data between this data buffer and the returned buffer is shared; though changes in the returned buffer's position will not be reflected in the reading nor writing position of this data buffer.

      注意，与DataBuffer.slice(int, int)不同，此方法 将对生成的切片调用 DataBufferUtils.retain(DataBuffer)（或等效方法）。

      Specified by:
      `retainedSlice` 接口 `DataBuffer` 中
      Parameters:
      index - 开始切片的位置索引
      length - 切片长度
      Returns:
      指定的、保留的数据缓冲区切片

    • split

      public NettyDataBuffer split(int index)
      描述从接口复制：DataBuffer
      Splits this data buffer into two at the given index.

      在 `index` 之前的数据将返回到一个新缓冲区中，而该缓冲区将包含 `index` 之后的数据。两个缓冲区之间的内存是共享的，但是独立的且不能重叠（不同于slice）。

      返回缓冲区的读和写位置在必要时会被截断以适配缓冲区的容量。如果这些位置小于index，则将其设置为0。

      Specified by:
      `split` 接口 `DataBuffer` 中
      Parameters:
      index - 应在此处分割的索引
      Returns:
      一个新的数据缓冲区，包含从索引 `0` 到 `index` 的字节。

    • readableByteBuffers

      public DataBuffer.ByteBufferIterator readableByteBuffers()
      描述从接口复制：DataBuffer
      Returns a closeable iterator over each ByteBuffer in this data buffer that can be read. Calling this method is more efficient than DataBuffer.toByteBuffer(), as no data is copied. However, the byte buffers provided can only be used during the iteration.

      注意，返回的迭代器必须在 try-with-resources 语句中使用，或显式地关闭。

      Specified by:
      `readableByteBuffers` 接口 `DataBuffer` 中
      Returns:
      一个可关闭的迭代器，用于遍历此数据缓冲区中包含的可读字节缓冲区。
